components.html: Report a suspected environmental or natural resource violation
components.label: Text/Images

components.html:
You can report suspected violations such as illegal hunting, fishing or trapping, polluting or dumping waste, burning when fire restrictions are in place, or using Crown land in ways that aren’t allowed.

We’ll send your report to the agency that handles it. You don’t have to provide your name or contact information.

This form is for non-urgent reports. If anyone is in immediate danger, call 911. For a violation happening now, call 1-877-952-7277 any time, day or night.

components.content:
Collection notice

Any personal information you provide will be collected for the purpose of receiving, assessing, investigating and responding to reports of suspected violations involving wildlife, natural resources and environmental protection. If you have any questions about the collection of this personal information, please contact:

[contact information of an officer or employee who can answer questions about the collection]

This information is being collected by the B.C. Compliance and Enforcement Agency under section 26(b), (c), and (e) of the Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Act.

components.html: Use one or more of the fields below to help staff find where it happened.
components.label: Text/Images
Nearest town or city (required)
components.description: Select the town or city closest to where the incident happened.

components.label: Search for an address and place a marker to show where it happened on a map.
HTML
components.content:
Latitude value must be between 60 and 48.2513 degrees
Longitude value must be between -139.0596 and -114.0337 degrees

components.label: Did this incident take place in a provincial park?
Location description
components.description: Include details that could help staff find the location, for example, a nearby landmark, trail or body of water.

components.label: Did you see it happen yourself?
Describe what you saw or know.
components.description: Include the actions involved, any effects, and any comments heard.

components.label: Person or people involved
components.description: If you know their name, include it. Describe details such as their approximate age or height, clothing, hair or distinctive features.

components.label: Witnesses
components.description: If anyone else saw what happened, you can include their name or contact details. Leave this out if they want to stay anonymous.

components.label: Vehicle, boat, aircraft or equipment
components.description: For a vehicle, boat or aircraft, include its licence plate or registration number and the province or state it’s from, if known. You can also include the make, model, colour or any distinctive features. For other equipment, describe what it was and how it was used.

components.label: Have you already reported this to another agency or service?
Which agency or service did you report it to? If you’re not sure, tell us the phone number you called or the website you used.

components.label: Do you have a file or reference number?

components.html:
A photo or document may help officers understand what happened. 
Photos should be in focus and documents should be readable. 

You can upload 5 files of up to 21 MB each, with a combined size of 50 MB.

You cannot upload:

  • Executable files
  • Script files
  • Web files
components.label: Text/Images
HTML
components.content: You can attach up to 5 files. Each file must be 21 MB or less, with a combined size of 50 MB or less.
